question_record.context: A security incident involving a suspicious click on a malicious URL, `https://dj01161621.bravesand-e1ccd718.eastus.azurecontainerapps.io/`, was reported. The click was made on the device named `vnevado-win11h` with the IP `172.33.118.200`. This activity involved the executable `msedge.exe` with a specific process ID `4256` created at the given time.
question_record.question: Related to this malicious URL, an email message containing it was delivered and later removed. Can you identify the sender of this email?
solution: The email account `raphaelt@vnevado.alpineskihouse.co` sent an email with a malicious URL.
The user `Hailey Johnson` clicked on the malicious URL.
